gnomes.title: Commonwealth Gnomes (guest tactics)
gnomes.research_note: Militia combinations and objective play; older aura/ability values differ from current cards.

faculty.title: The Faculty
faculty.research_note: Shared keywords enable cross-support; Overclock costs wounds and must be budgeted.

peggy.title: Peggy
peggy.research_note: Advance a self-sufficient Pirate; deployment mobility exposes it to ranged threats.

rogues.title: Lesh Miserables
rogues.research_note: Banked-card knives, turn-one movement discount and Pickles stone transfers.

swamp.title: Soggy Bottoms
swamp.research_note: Use qualifying catastrophe flips with Wenda; movement and Troll/Animal support matter.

greymair.title: Greymair
greymair.research_note: Drain Life can reset an energy-starved ally; Familiars support arcane reliability.

echo.title: Cohort of the King
echo.research_note: Starting Echo is more reliable than summoning; donate energy/healing to preserve his wound pool.

risen.title: The Shambling Soldiers of Moonreach
risen.research_note: Wound enemies before Soldier attacks; plan resurrection placement and death triggers.

lesh.title: The Liturgy of Leshavit
lesh.research_note: Energy enabling, linked Witches and carefully positioned catastrophes.

trees.title: Big Tree, Little Tree, Transforming Fox
trees.research_note: Wood placement and mobile Spirit/Animal partners; current cards govern numerical effects.

boris.title: Boris, Bunnies and Beasts
boris.research_note: Boris is a summoner; Animals and donated energy support his plan.

fauns.title: The Leader, The Warrior and The Toodles
fauns.research_note: Hoff supports Fauns; Jayda supplies ranged reach, Toodles support.

faeries.title: Feeble Faeries and How to Fizzlepop Them
faeries.research_note: Pulses avoid targeted defensive tools; reach, energy depletion and magic resistance counter Faeries.

barnakelle.title: Barnakelle
barnakelle.research_note: Water enables reanimation; energy donation can favour melee Trolls over casters.

brigid.title: Brigid
brigid.research_note: Flexible copied arcane actions; energy/wound exchanges have real costs.

commodore.title: Commodore Delahaye
commodore.research_note: Faction-specific mobility versus water; focus Pirate pistols on the Black Spot.

chezapeaky.title: Chezapeaky
chezapeaky.research_note: Free reload support and water-assisted healing; keep shooters unengaged.

iris.title: Iris & Hellebore
iris.research_note: Faerie melee support and reaction energy; verify current once-per-game Perfect Form.

dentia.title: Dentia
dentia.research_note: Energy and Weakling manipulation; Faerie endurance depends on avoiding counterplay.

banshee.title: Banshee
banshee.research_note: Bleeding support and disruption; Faerie/Spirit options need compatible faction.

firespitter.title: The Firespitter Revisited
firespitter.research_note: Fire damage and catastrophe planning; current card governs repeat casting.

matilda.title: Bing, Boing, Boom
matilda.research_note: Mobile ranged pressure and disengagement; movement actions restrict harvesting.

community.title: Player discussion: starter tactics
community.research_note: Players emphasise Goblin setup, healer coverage, and pairing Jobie with a reanimator. A reply incorrectly lists Jobie as dual faction: current card is Dominion only.

nobles.title: Noble Intentions
nobles.research_note: Move armoured fighters before carrying stones; support and energy budget matter more than taking every expensive Noble.

pirates.title: Goblin Pirate Strategy
pirates.research_note: Energy support and safe hit-and-run positioning; current cards supersede older costs.

olim.title: Olim
olim.research_note: Set up Norse flips and charge lanes; older passives differ from the current card.

knoll.title: Knoll
knoll.research_note: Budget energy for Trollish Remedies and support Troll durability; current faction is authoritative.

monsters.title: Fantastic Monsters and How to Field Them
monsters.research_note: Large models need energy and objective support; current targeting restrictions take precedence.

liv.title: Liv
liv.research_note: Sequence deck preparation and her own casting before arranging unused cards.

bjorn.title: Bjørn
bjorn.research_note: Balance wound-powered damage with survival; charge can disable opposing signatures.

spirits.title: Visitors from the Deadlands
spirits.research_note: Marley improves Spirit mobility and resist hands; protect curse casters.

pomps.title: A Party of Parading Psychopomps!
pomps.research_note: Thralls share summoner energy; Roary can enable efficient harvesting and specialist actions.
